name: EMR Serverless Job Sensor
description: This node will periodically check if the state of the EMR Serverless Job run reaches any of the target states.

fields.name: Name
fields.title: Task Name
fields.description: Unique name of the task in Airflow DAG.

fields.name: ApplicationId
fields.title: Application ID
fields.description: If Application ID is empty, the step tries to pick the Application ID from previous create EMRServerless application node(task)

fields.name: targetStates
fields.title: Target States
fields.description: The target states, sensor waits until job reaches any of these states added in comma separated.

fields.name: failedStates
fields.title: Failed States
fields.description: The failure states, sensor fails when job reaches any of these states added in comma separated.

fields.name: retry_exponential_backoff
fields.title: Retry Exponential Backoff
fields.description: Allow progressive longer waits between retries by using exponential backoff algorithm on retry delay
